evidence.quote: The pre-enrolment procedure was digitized with the launch of the Universitaly portal.

Non-EU candidates who receive the letter of eligibility for enrolment in a bachelor’s or master’s degree program must complete the pre-enrolment procedure by logging in to the Universitaly portal and filling in the application online.

notes: Tuition left out: the only fee quoted on the programme page ("Tuition fee €2,385 per year") is not labelled as the amount for a non-EU student living abroad, and the university's fee pages use ISEE-based bands. The application deadline for non-EU applicants is not given as a quotable date for this programme; the pages only quote TOLC-E test and enrolment dates (e.g. 28 August 2026, 18 December 2026) which are not the programme application deadline for international applicants. The English B2 requirement: the pages say a minimum B2-level knowledge of English is mandatory for enrolment but the recognised certifications are not named in the quoted pages, so acceptedTests is empty.

evidence.quote: A minimum B2-level knowledge of English is mandatory for enrolment.
A minimum B2-level knowledge of English is mandatory for enrolment.
Students must have attended school for at least 12 years in order to be eligible to enrol in a bachelor’s degree offered by an Italian university.
Applicants to bachelor's degree programmes must have completed at least 12 years of schooling and obtained a secondary school leaving qualification.

note.fr: Admission limitée : test d'entrée écrit en ligne (TOLC-E ou SAT ou CEnT-S) portant sur les mathématiques et le raisonnement. Les candidats non-UE doivent avoir les résultats au moment de la soumission.
note.en: Limited-admission programme: online written entry test (TOLC-E or SAT or CEnT-S) on mathematics and reasoning. Non-EU visa applicants must already hold official results at the moment of submission.

evidence.quote: This is a limited-admission programme that requires you to take an online written entry test that evaluates your knowledge of mathematics and reasoning.

Non-European applicants requiring a visa must take one of the recognized tests. These applicants must already have their official results of one of the accepted entry tests AT THE MOMENT OF SUBMISSION.

note.fr: Mathématiques : note minimale de 6/13 à la section mathématiques du TOLC-E, sinon obligation de formation supplémentaire (OFA). L'OFA doit être satisfaite avant les examens.
note.en: Mathematics: minimum score of 6 out of 13 in the TOLC-E mathematics section, otherwise an Additional Learning Requirement (OFA) is assigned. The OFA must be fulfilled before sitting exams.

evidence.quote: candidates who do not achieve a minimum score of 6 out of 13 in the mathematics section will be assigned an Additional Learning Requirement – ALR (Obbligo Formativo Aggiuntivo – OFA)
If you do not fulfill the OFA by September 30th, 2027, you will not be allowed to take any exams included in your study plan until its fulfillment.
